in_english.name: Rasheeqah
in_english.long_meaning: Rasheeqah is an Arabic name that means beautiful, elegant, and well-proportioned. It is derived from the root word 'rashq', which means to hit or strike the target. The name Rasheeqah conveys a sense of beauty, elegance, and refinement. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with positive qualities such as kindness, compassion, and generosity. Historically, the name Rasheeqah has been used in various Muslim cultures, including Arabic, Urdu, and Turkish communities. The name is also mentioned in some Quranic commentaries as a description of the righteous and virtuous individuals.
